trader.cmd.npc: /anpc here trader <shop> | here banker | here stable | remove | list - stand a trader, a banker or a stablemaster where you stand, take away the one in front of you, or list them
trader.not_in_world: You have to be in the world to stand a trader.
trader.not_settled: The server still has you in cell {seen}, but you stand in cell {here}: the game has not caught up after a long jump. Walk a few steps, or rejoin, and try again.
trader.placed: A {shop} trader stands here now (#{id}). They appear in a moment.
trader.placed_banker: A banker stands here now (#{id}). They appear in a moment.
trader.placed_stablemaster: A stablemaster stands here now (#{id}). They appear in a moment.
trader.place_failed: The trader could not be saved, so none stands here. Try again in a moment.
trader.none_in_front: No trader stands in front of you.
trader.remove_failed: Trader #{id} could not be taken away and still stands. Try again in a moment.
trader.label: Trader
trader.nothing_to_sell: This trader has nothing to sell.
trader.unknown_ware: This trader does not sell that.
trader.count: Buy from 1 to {max} at a time.
trader.too_poor: That costs {price} gold and you carry {gold}.
trader.failed: The purchase could not be completed. You kept your gold.
trader.closed_far: You walked more than {metres} m away from the trader.
trader.closed_not_in_world: You left the world, so the trader's window closed.
